phase: architecture scope assessment before implementation freeze
decision: Host-recognized disconnect interval unknown is a hardware-validation limit, not by itself a blocker to owner-authorized Option C coordinated local hardware/software reset A/B candidate.
conditions: No full cold-class-state reset claim: CDC coding and initialized lock infrastructure intentionally retained
No source proof or advance claim of host-recognized detach or dependable enumeration
Exact local quiesce/order/queue/class/control/DCD/IRQ ownership and read-only/manual-only invariants must pass independent frozen-source review
No timing delays, retry loops, new polling observer, descriptor or VID/PID redesign
Any unresolved local lifecycle safety invariant forces ARCHITECTURE_READY rather than CANDIDATE_READY
rationale: Owner expressly permits a source-grounded coordinated peripheral+software restart as the first A/B candidate, excludes combining timing delays, and reserves normal-control plus actual RT2 transport success to future hardware acceptance. Whether the host recognizes this one local restart is the experiment, not a precondition proven by host models.
